[L6043-L6047,L7144-L7146,L7155-L7158,L7187-L7189] (LOW/platform-matching) Several branches match the full host triplet against bare sysv4 or osf3 patterns, preventing their intended platform-specific handling.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: The macro requires a canonical host, but these nested cases compare $host with patterns beginning directly with sysv4 or osf3 instead of matching $host_os. The cited SNI and OSF branches therefore miss their intended CPU-vendor-OS triplets, with the OSF cases taking the generic alternative.
